# Security policy

Senpai_Bot is an early `0.0.x` development preview. There is currently no official public release.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not open a public issue or discussion containing exploit details, private data, credentials, or other sensitive information.

Use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting form instead:

https://github.com/DevilMedlar/python-recall-training/security/advisories/new

Include, when possible:

- the affected commit or version;
- your Windows version and relevant environment details;
- clear reproduction steps;
- the expected and observed behavior;
- the potential impact; and
- logs or screenshots with credentials, tokens, usernames, and personal paths removed.

If private vulnerability reporting is unavailable, do not publish the report. Wait until the repository owner enables the private reporting channel.

## Scope

This file covers security reporting for the GitHub repository and Senpai_Bot application code. `Senpai_Bot/SECURITY.md` is separate bot curriculum/contract content and is not the repository vulnerability-reporting policy.
